Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Interiors Furniture Store specializes in the sale of high-quality, handcrafted furniture, offering a diverse range of living room, bedroom, and office furniture. We provide installation services for our products, ensuring a seamless experience for our customers. Our showroom features modern designs alongside classic styles, catering to a wide array of customer preferences. We maintain a robust inventory valued between $500,000 and $1 million, with enhanced security measures and regular inventory audits in place. We prioritize customer satisfaction and safety, employing trained installers who adhere to strict loss prevention protocols. Additionally, all subcontractors used for delivery and installation are fully insured, safeguarding against potential liabilities.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a delivery incident resulted in damage to a customer's property and merchandise, leading to a claim of $10,000, currently under review. On August 22, 2023, during installation, an installer accidentally scratched a wall in the customer's home, valued at $5,000, which has been settled. In total, losses amounted to $15,000.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Full-time security personnel on-site during business hours, surveillance cameras throughout the store and parking lot, and a monitored alarm system with immediate response capabilities.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Inventory values between $500,000 and $1 million, subject to enhanced security measures
and periodic inventory audits.
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses primarily dealing in used, refurbished, or private-label furniture, due to higher
product liability and quality control risks.
– Operations with primarily online-only sales exceeding 75% without robust cyber liability
coverage and proven fulfillment controls.
– Entities exhibiting financial instability, poor credit history, or lacking documented loss
prevention and safety programs.
– Businesses without clear documentation of subcontractor insurance or those relying on
uninsured subcontractors for delivery or installation.
Key Risk Considerations
• Damage during delivery or installation: Furniture is often bulky, fragile, and expensive.
